headlines.description: — Ryan O’Hearn homered twice in a game for the third time in the majors and drove in four runs to help the Pittsburgh Pirates avoid a series sweep with a 9-4 win over the Cincinnati Reds on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan O'Hearn homers twice, helps Pirates avoid sweep with 9-4 win over Reds

headlines.description: — Luis García Jr. homered twice and drove in five runs to lead the Washington Nationals to a 6-4 victory over the Baltimore Orioles on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: García's 2 home runs lift Nationals to a 6-4 victory over Orioles

events.name: Texas Rangers at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Pinch-runner Jarred Kelenic scored the tiebreaking run by racing home from second base on a wild pitch in the ninth inning, and the Texas Rangers beat the Toronto Blue Jays 3-2 on Sunday to complete a four-game sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rangers complete 4-game sweep of slumping Blue Jays with 3-2 victory

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Junior Caminero homered in a career-best fourth consecutive game, Drew Rasmussen threw six shutout innings and the Tampa Bay Rays finished a sweep of the Arizona Diamondbacks with a 5-1 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caminero homers again, Rasmussen throws 6 shutout innings as Rays sweep Diamondbacks with 5-1 win

headlines.description: — Christian Walker's three-run homer highlighted a four-run 10th inning as the Houston Astros rallied to beat the Detroit Tigers 7-5 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Christian Walker's 3-run homer in 10th inning helps power Astros past Tigers 7-5

events.name: Philadelphia Phillies at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Kyle Schwarber became the first major leaguer to reach 30 homers this season with a two-run shot in the seventh inning that sent the Philadelphia Phillies to a 5-4 win over the New York Mets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyle Schwarber sets Phillies record with MLB-best 30th homer in 5-4 win over Mets

headlines.description: — Rhys Hoskins had a two-run double down the left-field line during a five-run eighth inning and the Cleveland Guardians rallied for a 6-5 victory over the Seattle Mariners on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guardians use 5-run 8th inning to rally for 6-5 win over Mariners

headlines.description: — Seiya Suzuki singled in two runs to key a three-run 10th inning and Jordan Wicks, called up earlier Sunday, got a game-ending double play with the bases loaded to preserve the Chicago Cubs 4-3 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers in the decider of the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Seiya Suzuki hits in 2 runs in 10th to push Cubs over Brewers 4-3

headlines.description: — Connor Prielipp struck out a career-high 10 in six innings, Ryan Kreidler hit a go-ahead home run in the seventh and the Minnesota Twins edged the Colorado Rockies 3-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prielipp fans 10 as the Twins edge the Rockies 3-2 on Kreidler’s late homer

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Carter Jensen extended his franchise-record rookie hitting streak to 19 games and five Kansas City Royals relievers held the Chicago White Sox scoreless for five innings to end a four-game losing streak with a 5-4 win Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carter Jensen extends his hitting streak as the Royals avoid sweep in 5-4 win over the White Sox

events.name: Miami Marlins at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Bryan Torres hit a two-run homer to back Kyle Leahy's stingy start as the St. Louis Cardinals cooled off the Miami Marlins with a 2-1 victory Sunday that snapped a four-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Torres hits 2-run homer to help Leahy and Cardinals cool off Marlins with 2-1 win

events.name: Athletics Athletics at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Josh Lowe's first career grand slam was all the offense the Los Angeles Angels needed Sunday in a 4-1 victory over the Athletics.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Lowe's first career grand slam leads Angels to 4-1 win over Athletics

events.name: Atlanta Braves at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Robbie Ray outpitched Chris Sale in a matchup of Cy Young Award winners and the San Francisco Giants held off the Atlanta Braves 3-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ray outduels Sale in Cy Young matchup and Giants hold off slumping Braves 3-2 to take series

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Freddie Freeman drew a tiebreaking, bases-loaded walk off suddenly wild Michael King in the fifth inning and Mookie Betts followed with a two-run single for the Los Angeles Dodgers, who beat the San Diego Padres 4-2 Sunday to take two of three.
headlines.shortLinkText: Freeman, Betts key big inning as Dodgers beat the Padres 4-2 to take 2 of 3 in the series

events.name: New York Yankees at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Jarren Duran singled home the winning run to cap a three-run rally in the 10th inning after Boston blew a two-run lead in the ninth, and the Red Sox finished a four-game sweep of the rival New York Yankees with a 5-4 victory Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Sox rally past Yankees 5-4 in 10 innings to complete 4-game sweep after Gray loses no-hit bid
